reason: The Annual Report 2019 for Infineon Technologies AG does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document contains market position data (e.g., #2 in automotive semiconductors with 11.2% market share, #1 in IGBT-based power semiconductors with 28.6% market share, #1 in power MOSFETs with 27.7% market share, #2 in smart card and secure ICs with 24.3% market share) based on third-party analyst sources (Strategy Analytics, Informa Tech/IHS Markit, ABI Research). However, these are market share rankings, not TAM disclosures. The company discusses structural growth drivers, revenue by segment (Automotive: €3,503M, Industrial Power Control: €1,418M, Power Management & Multimarket: €2,445M, Digital Security Solutions: €642M), and strategic focus areas (Energy Efficiency, Mobility, IoT & Big Data, Security), but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM figures for these markets. The Cypress acquisition discussion mentions expected revenue synergies of >€1.5 billion annually long-term, but this is not a TAM disclosure. No 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, investor day, or earnings call TAM data is presented in this filing excerpt.
